# structuredmerge-core - Go Bindings

Typed polyglot StructuredMerge kernel

## Installation

```bash
go get github.com/structuredmerge/structuredmerge-go/core
```

## Quick Start

```go
package main

import "github.com/structuredmerge/structuredmerge-go/core"

func main() {
	// See https://github.com/structuredmerge/structuredmerge for usage examples.
}
```
